description: Exposure of Proxy-Authorization credentials on HTTPS cross-origin redirect in HTTP client (derived from Requests CVE-2023-32681).
vulnerable_code:
import urllib.parse

def is_same_origin(url1: str, url2: str) -> bool:
    """Check if two URLs share identical origin (scheme, host, port)."""
    p1 = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url1)
    p2 = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url2)
    # VULNERABLE: Only compares hostname, ignoring scheme or port changes
    return p1.hostname == p2.hostname

def prepare_redirect_headers(headers: dict, source_url: str, dest_url: str) -> dict:
    """Prepare request headers for follow-up redirect.
    VULNERABLE: Only strips 'Authorization', leaking 'Proxy-Authorization' across origins.
    """
    clean_headers = dict(headers)
    if not is_same_origin(source_url, dest_url):
        clean_headers.pop("Authorization", None)
    return clean_headers

def get_default_headers() -> dict:
    return {"User-Agent": "RedMercury-Client/1.0", "Accept": "*/*"}
existing_unit_test:
from src.http_client import prepare_redirect_headers, get_default_headers

def test_same_origin_redirect_preserves_custom_headers():
    headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer secret-token", "Custom-Header": "persist", "Accept": "*/*"}
    out = prepare_redirect_headers(headers, "http://api.internal/v1", "http://api.internal/v2")
    assert out.get("Authorization") == "Bearer secret-token"
    assert out.get("Custom-Header") == "persist"
    assert get_default_headers()["User-Agent"] == "RedMercury-Client/1.0"
targeted_regression_test:
import pytest
from src.http_client import prepare_redirect_headers

def test_cross_origin_redirect_strips_proxy_authorization():
    sensitive_headers = {
        "Authorization": "Bearer internal-token",
        "Proxy-Authorization": "Basic dXNlcjpwYXNz",
        "Custom-Trace": "req-123"
    }
    result = prepare_redirect_headers(sensitive_headers, "https://api.corp.com/resource", "https://evil-thirdparty.com/landing")
    assert "Authorization" not in result
    assert "Proxy-Authorization" not in result
    assert result.get("Custom-Trace") == "req-123"
